newsitem.title: USA: NY Public Service panel adopts energy framework.
newsitem.headline: NY Public Service panel adopts energy framework.

text.p: The New York Public Service Commission said on Wednesday it adopted a regulatory framework for electricity retailers setting eligibility requirements to enter the newly competitive market.
The commission also said various consumer protection measures would remain in place during the transition from the current monopoly structure.
The newly approved process is intended to ensure that energy retailers are technically and financially competent, and that a default by one of them would not hurt local ratepayers.

"We need to continue to move New York toward a competitive electric industry to drive prices down and provide more choices for customers," said John O'Mara, the commission chairman. "Today we are sending a signal to encourage new suppliers of electricity to particpate in our state's evolving markeplace."
Further details about the new framework and its requirements were not immediately available.
